## What this does

Produces the **read-only inspection of the actual open PR stack plus the
ordered, operator-runnable integration and rollback procedure** — committed as
`docs/build/reports/p33.6-integration-plan/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md`. This ticket
ran only `gh pr list/view`, `git` read operations, a throwaway
detached-worktree merge simulation under `/tmp`, and
`docs/build/tools/merge_dryrun.sh`. Every mutating step in the plan is a
reviewable, **unexecuted** command for the operator.

**Inspection findings (the plan's §(a)–§(c)):**
- 75 OPEN PRs (#112–#187; #148 already merged) inventoried bottom-up with
  base/head/SHA/diffstat; five seed bases ride in transitively.
- `origin/main` = `3b913c6f` (the PR-#111 merge); the stack's fork commit is
  `5b7fed0e` — and **`main`'s tree is byte-identical to the fork's tree**, so
  main has moved but not diverged content-wise.
- Real conflicts at exactly three merge steps — **#113 and #117**
  (`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md`; twelve branches carry an out-of-chain tip
  commit, two of them DEFERRALS cell edits the incoming files already carry)
  and **#155** (`web/package-lock.json` — the `@types/node` 26.6.2→26.6.3
  delta; the Round-10 chain's lockfile is authoritative). Resolution is
  `git checkout --theirs` per the conflict table; the simulated accumulated
  final tree is **byte-identical to PR #187's head tree**.
- `merge_dryrun.sh`: Pass A all-clean; Pass B stops at #113 as documented.
- Order is load-bearing for `db/sqitch.plan` (26 commits, pure appends),
  `DEFERRALS.md`, `LEDGER.md`, `BUILD_INDEX.md`, `BACKLOG.*`, `adr/README.md`,
  `spec_src` — ascending PR order only.

**The procedure (§(e)):** ascending loop `gh pr edit <N> --base main` →
`gh pr merge <N> --merge --delete-branch=false`; conflict steps landed
locally with the tabled resolution + `make check` before pushing; STOP on any
undocumented conflict. **Rollback (§(f)):** `merge --abort` pre-push;
`git revert -m 1` in reverse order post-push; a mid-run halt is safe.
**Obligations (§(g)):** the entire owed register carries forward — integration
discharges nothing (deferred S3 spine, `prepared_not_executed` live passes,
`D-R10-PUBLISH-1`, `D-R10-MEMORY-1`, `D-P32.10a-1`/`D-P32.16a-1`, `SIG-MEM-004`
→ P33.8, all 36 DEFERRALS rows).

`docs/build/INTEGRATION_PLAN.md` (P20.3) gains a dated supersession pointer —
it stays as the dated record; its `v0.1.0` tag step never ran and the current
plan has no tag/release step.
